description: This Java class handles the deletion of a client family member, acting as a command handler within the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface to process delete commands for family members by invoking the appropriate service.

classes.name: DeleteClientFamilyMemberCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles delete commands for client family members, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the deleteFamilyMember method on the write platform service with the command's entity ID and the command object itself.
